notes.title: Version 0.89 published!
notes.content:
In this release I have included an option for different snapping points when grabbing fruit, hoping to alleviate some user's difficulty throwing, specifically to the watermelon bin.
To change, enter the settings menu and toggle through the grab options. You can try each option right away. Please let me know if this helped or not for those of you having trouble! Thanks!

Other small changes:
- Added cut pineapple
- Brought lever and table closer to the center of the playspace
- Added hover states to most interactables
- Added better messaging in tutorial for watermelon misses
- Moved height/center handles to the settings panel
- Removed exit bin
- Removed raycast blocking from fruit
- Doubled fruit's mass
- Fix for child double laugh

notes.title: Version 0.87 published!
notes.content:
Adding some more fixes from player comments!
Thanks for the feedback! We are fixing bugs as we hear about them!

- Fixed decent framerate killing bug with the particle trail emitters
- Fixed more spawn issues with candy bar and knife
- Fixed collision on trash bin
- Fixed floor box collision and corresponding splats
- Added some more Oculus support - Added mesh and proper key names in tutorial
- Other small fixes

An upcoming build will have some optional changes to the throw mechanics to test how it feels, so stay tuned!

notes.content:
This update fixed some initial headaches with the release, and fixed some game play bugs.

Some of the fixes include:
- Fixed mouse focus
- Fixed audio focus
- Fixed collision on the watermelon bin
- Fixed candy bar spawning
- The knife now respawns faster
and many other small fixes
